name: BLACKBOX Heixiang LSS - Ciai de Jiujizhe
source:
Immerse yourself in this medium-length visual novel brimming with romance. The protagonist is a member of a special minority group. The game offers a story of his journey as he forges connections with his online friend, and gradually falls in love.
While this game unfolds in the same universe as our previous title "[url=https://vndb.org/v37501]Black Box - The Shining Immortal[/url]", new players can still dive straight in without missing a beat. Set against the backdrop of a futuristic sci-fi world, this medium-length game unfolds within a vast world full of intrigue. Beautifully illustrated in pixel art, and a riveting soundtrack that sets the mood for this love story. The game's rich dialogue and introspective monologues are presented in a simple and easily understood manner.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2435810/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
沉浸在这部充满恋爱元素的中篇视觉小说中。主角属于一个特殊的少数族群。故事讲述他如何与网友建立联系，并逐渐坠入爱河。

本作与前作[url=https://vndb.org/v37501]《Black Box - The Shining Immortal》[/url]发生在同一个世界，但新玩家也可以直接开始游玩，不会错过关键内容。故事以未来科幻世界为背景，在一个广阔而充满阴谋的世界中展开。精美的像素画风配上烘托恋爱氛围的动人配乐。丰富的对话和内省独白以简明易懂的方式呈现。[引自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2435810/]Steam[/url]]
